verdict: Ads are running but zero leads are being captured — this is being fixed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, $142.84 was spent on Meta ads and generated 294 clicks, but zero leads were recorded — not because the ads aren't reaching people, but because the conversion tracking needed to capture those leads is not yet in place. This is the direct result of several setup milestones that are overdue, including landing pages, tracking, and conversion infrastructure that were scheduled for completion on July 31. Work to close those gaps is underway now and is the team's top priority. In parallel, your Google Business Profile drove 89 actions this period — 11 calls, 47 direction requests, and 31 website clicks — showing real local interest while the paid infrastructure is completed. Once tracking is live, lead capture will reflect the actual volume of interest your ads and profile are already generating.

highlights.phrase: spent on Meta ads this period, with 294 clicks delivered but zero leads captured due to a tracking gap
actions on your Google Business Profile this period, including 11 calls and 47 direction requests
spike in ad spend in the most recent 7 days, while organic profile engagement declined — flagged and being managed

watch_item.issue: Conversion tracking is not recording leads, making every ad dollar currently unaccountable.
watch_item.fix: Landing pages and conversion tracking are being stood up now — this is the team's immediate focus and is required before lead numbers can be reported accurately.
